_readme: Business settings for the OHAS website. Edit values here; the site reads everything from this file. Anything with "confirmed": false stays hidden on the live site and is only shown in review mode (add ?review=1 to the URL).
name: OHAS Boulangerie & Café
subtitle: Boulangerie & Café
_siteUrl_note: CONFIRM BEFORE LAUNCH: replace with the real domain. Used for canonical URLs, Open Graph and the sitemap.

address.line1: Corner of Beach Road & Orchid Street
address.landmarks: North of Joeten Garapan, next to Garapan Elementary School

links._mapEmbed_note: Embeds OHAS’s own Google Maps listing by its ID (same listing as googleMaps). An address search landed in the wrong part of Saipan.

hours._note: CONFIRM BEFORE LAUNCH. "schedule" is pre-filled with OHAS’s most recent post (Apr 28, 2026); set "confirmed": true and "confirmedOn" once OHAS confirms. Days use schema.org codes: Mo Tu We Th Fr Sa Su. Times are 24-hour, Saipan time.
hours.unconfirmedMessage: Opening hours are being confirmed. Please call before you visit.

candidates.value: Mon–Fri 8:00 a.m. – 6:00 p.m.; Sat–Sun 8:00 a.m. – 7:00 p.m.
candidates.source: OHAS Instagram post, Apr 28, 2026 (reopening after Typhoon Sinlaku) and current Instagram bio — most recent

space._note: Facts about the building. Items with "confirmed": false are hidden on the live site until OHAS confirms them (Wi-Fi, parking, payment and accessibility are on the confirm-before-launch list).

items.label: Two floors
items.detail: A two-story bakery-café with an upstairs food station

items.label: Upstairs seating
items.detail: A second-floor seating area, with a long table for groups

items.label: Terrace
items.detail: A second-floor terrace for watching Beach Road go by

services._note: Only switch these on when OHAS actually offers them. Each needs a real URL.

cakeOrderForm._note: CONFIRM BEFORE LAUNCH: only keep this on if OHAS wants an order-request form. With "endpoint" empty, the form prepares the request for the customer to call or message OHAS (nothing is sent anywhere). Set "endpoint" to a form service URL that accepts JSON POST to have requests delivered to OHAS.

sisterLocation._note: CONFIRM: whether to list the OHAS café at Kensington Hotel Saipan as a sister location, and its hours.
sisterLocation.name: OHAS at Kensington Hotel Saipan
